input.explanation:
Fault: average_spend_per_item_this_month divides the month's total by the number of purchases made this month without checking that there are any. For any account whose current-month purchase list is empty - a new shopper, or anyone who simply hasn't bought yet this month - len(bought) is 0 and the integer division raises ZeroDivisionError, failing the whole account page request. The line was latent until traffic from such accounts reached it; nothing had to change for it to break, so there is nothing to revert and the guard has to live in the code.

Fix: treat "no purchases this month" as an average of 0 cents and return early, so the division only runs when there is at least one item. The behaviour for shoppers who did buy is unchanged (same floor division of the month total by the item count).

Also fixed Account.__init__, which accepted total_cents and total_this_month_cents but only stored purchases; every read of account.total_this_month_cents would have raised AttributeError. Both attributes are now assigned.

Tests: tests/io_shop/test_spend_summary.py now covers the regression (an account with no current-month purchases returns 0 rather than raising), the previously empty happy path, an account whose purchases are all from earlier months, and that the Account constructor records the totals it is given.

files.content:
from io_shop.accounts import Account
from io_shop.spend_summary import average_spend_per_item_this_month


class Purchase:
    def __init__(self, in_current_month):
        self.in_current_month = in_current_month


def test_the_monthly_average_is_correct_for_a_shopper_who_did_buy():
    account = Account(
        purchases=[Purchase(True), Purchase(True), Purchase(False)],
        total_cents=5000,
        total_this_month_cents=1500,
    )

    assert average_spend_per_item_this_month(account) == 750


def test_a_shopper_with_no_purchases_at_all_averages_zero():
    account = Account(purchases=[], total_cents=0, total_this_month_cents=0)

    assert average_spend_per_item_this_month(account) == 0


def test_a_shopper_who_bought_nothing_this_month_averages_zero():
    account = Account(
        purchases=[Purchase(False), Purchase(False)],
        total_cents=9900,
        total_this_month_cents=0,
    )

    assert average_spend_per_item_this_month(account) == 0


def test_the_average_floors_to_whole_cents():
    account = Account(
        purchases=[Purchase(True), Purchase(True), Purchase(True)],
        total_cents=1000,
        total_this_month_cents=1000,
    )

    assert average_spend_per_item_this_month(account) == 333


def test_account_records_the_totals_it_is_given():
    account = Account(purchases=[], total_cents=4200, total_this_month_cents=100)

    assert account.purchases == []
    assert account.total_cents == 4200
    assert account.total_this_month_cents == 100

input.summary: Return zero average spend when an account has no purchases this month instead of dividing by zero
